description: This file defines the ThreadLooper class and related utility functions for scheduling and managing delayed or immediate callback execution in a multithreaded environment, specifically for the modem simulator component within the Android Open Source Project.

classes.name: ThreadLooper
classes.description: A class that manages a thread loop for scheduling callbacks with optional delays, supporting cancellation and safe callback creation.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be executed immediately or after a specified delay.

methods.name: CancelSerial
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled event based on its serial number.

methods.name: makeSafeCallback
methods.description: Creates a thread-safe callback wrapper around a member function or function object.
